vendor_models.ibm_heron: Qiskit Aer NoiseModel.from_backend(FakeBoston) — IBM's ibm_boston snapshot (qiskit-ibm-runtime)
vendor_models.ibm_nighthawk: Qiskit Aer NoiseModel.from_backend(FakeMiami) — IBM's ibm_miami snapshot
vendor_models.google_willow: Cirq NoiseModelFromGoogleNoiseProperties(load_device_noise_properties('willow_pink')); also run with the measurement duration set to 0 in its thermal model

workload: QPUTwin's compiled circuit (SABRE seed 0; asserted equal to the worker's) run unchanged, on the same physical qubits, through the vendor's own noise model built from the same published snapshot. QPUTwin full = with idle-window decoherence from its ASAP schedule; no-idle = without (neither vendor model idles an unscheduled circuit). median-only = an Aer model with one median value per gate type and per-device T1/T2/readout, i.e. a twin without per-qubit data. Hellinger fidelity to the exact ideal distribution; tvd = total-variation distance to the vendor model's distribution; tvd_sampling_floor = the vendor model against itself with another seed (the distance two independent 100 000-shot samples of one distribution show). 100 000 shots each
